page: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is a compute-oriented virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, backed by 32 MB of L3 cache and advanced vector capabilities including AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 support. Memory capacity stands at 32 GB RAM, supplying 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local scratch storage is bundled with a 945 GB NVMe SSD, though no discrete GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned.

Benchmark data highlights exceptionally strong single-threaded CPU capabilities. In stress-ng single-core execution, the instance ranks in the top tier (3,623.48), paired with leading throughput in single-threaded compression and decompression tasks (39.48 GB/s for gzip and 17.87 GB/s for bzip3). Multi-core throughput remains in the middle percentile, recording a PassMark CPU score of 24,323.24 and stress-ng multi-core score of 29,294.17. Memory bandwidth achieves 62.38 GB/s for large uncached reads and 38.95 GB/s for writes. The hardware also shows competitive CPU-driven inference execution on smaller models, reaching 358.88 tokens per second on 135M parameter generation tests.

From an operational tradeoff perspective, the absence of simultaneous multithreading (SMT) ensures isolated, predictable execution per dedicated core at high clock speeds, avoiding resource contention between threads. The bundled 945 GB NVMe SSD provides fast local scratch space without network storage latency overhead. The instance is suited for compute-intensive single-threaded tasks, software compilation, batch compression pipelines, lightweight machine learning inference, and web serving applications requiring dedicated per-core processing.
description: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is a compute-focused instance featuring 8 dedicated x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V45 physical cores operating at up to 4.5 GHz with one thread per core. It is configured with 32 GB of system memory, 32 MB of L3 cache, and AVX-512 instruction extensions including VNNI and BF16. Local storage includes a 945 GB NVMe SSD, while discrete GPU acceleration is not present. Benchmark results show top-tier single-core computation, achieving 3,623.48 in stress-ng and 39.48 GB/s in single-threaded gzip compression. Multi-threaded processing and memory bandwidth align within median expectations, scoring 24,323.24 in PassMark CPU tests. The dedicated core architecture and integrated high-speed local disk make the F8ads_v7 well suited for computationally intensive single-thread workflows, batch data transformation, lightweight CPU-based model inference, and high-frequency web serving.
